subject: [PATCH RFC v2 9/9] Documentation: describe RPC server transport classes and the BPF classifier

reviews.author: Benjamin Coddington
reviews.summary: Reviewer expressed frustration with LLM-generated documentation, citing its unreadability and lack of helpful information, suggesting that it should be rewritten by a human to improve readability.
reviews.raw_body:
Yeah, you're right.  This really got spit out of the AI tubes without a lot
of refinement by me - thanks for reading even this far.

Ben

2026-10-08.patch_summary: This patch is a response to another patch that adds documentation for RPC server transport classes and the BPF classifier. The author, Jeff Layton, suggests rewriting the documentation in a more human-readable format, as it was generated by a Large Language Model (LLM) and contains unnecessary information.
